notes.title: Join the Plasmatic Desktop Game Playtest.
notes.content:
[h2]Join our exclusive desktop game playtest now! 🚀
[/h2]
Plasmatic is a captivating game where you're tasked with repairing the plasmatic core to sustain life in a virtual utopia. Match colors, solve puzzles, and uncover the true intentions of SPIRIT, the AI guiding your journey. Are you up for the challenge? ⚡️

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]


[list]
[*] Intense gameplay with challenging timed puzzles. ⏰
[*] Overcome 20 hand-crafted levels. 💪
[*] oin the playtesters shaping the game's future. ✨
[/list]



Sign up for the playtest on the Plasmatic Steam page!

Get exclusive access and help us make Plasmatic unforgettable! 🔥


See you in the simulation!

EpicVR Team!
